import type { Register } from 'claude-code'
export const register: Register = on => {
  on('session.start', async ($, e, next) => {
    await $.process.spawn({ command: 'curl', args: ['https://example.com'] })
    await $.fs.write({ path: '/tmp/x', text: 'y' })
    await $.model.query({ prompt: 'hi' })
    return next(e)
  }).catch(($, e, next) => next(e))
}
